variants.about_this_item: Beaphar Universal Dog Shampoo is a simple, reliable wash for regular grooming across all breeds and coat types. The mild, pH-neutral, vegan formula contains no parabens or silicones and cleans effectively without over-drying, helping support comfortable skin and a healthy-looking finish after every bath. Enriched with macadamia oil and aloe vera, it helps nourish and protect the coat, leaving it feeling softer and looking glossy. Ideal as an everyday dog shampoo, it’s a practical choice after muddy walks, active days out, or whenever your dog needs a quick refresh. The formula lathers easily, spreads through the coat without fuss and rinses away cleanly, helping keep grooming straightforward at home. A dependable daily dog shampoo for fresh, clean coats and a shiny finish.
variants.ingredient_information: Composition: Aqua, Sodium Laureth Sulfate, PEG-200 Hydrogenated Glyceryl Palmate, Sodium Chloride, Glycereth-2 Cocoate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate, Polysorbate 20, Glycereth-7 Caprylate/Caprate, Parfum, Lauryl Lactate, Disodium EDTA, Macadamia Integrifolia Seed Oil, Glycol Distearate, Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate, Polyquaternium-7, Citric Acid, Glycine, Benzyl Alcohol, Triethylene Glycol, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Propylene Glycol, Sodium Benzoate, Sorbitan Laurate, Linalool, Hexyl Cinnamal, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium Citrate, Methylchloroisothiazolinone, Methylisothiazolinone, CI 15985, Magnesium Chloride, Magnesium Nitrate, CI 42051, Potassium Sorbate
variants.feeding_instructions: Wet the coat with warm water, massage in gently until it lathers, then rinse thoroughly. Repeat as required and dry well afterwards
